Oracle shares rally: Can strong AI demand sustain Oracle’s stock surge?

Oracle shares jumped in after-hours trading after the software giant reported stronger-than-expected fiscal first-quarter results, with booming AI demand driving rapid growth in its cloud infrastructure business. The results helped ease some investor concerns over Oracle’s heavy spending on AI infra
